title: Wizard at Ancient Gate
description: A hooded wizard stands with back to viewer in the center foreground, arms raised with glowing hands, facing a massive open iron gate set between two enormous stone pillars covered in glowing runes. The gate is chained with an ornate golden chain and padlock, with a misty castle visible in the distant background under a purple twilight sky.
prompt: A hooded wizard in a dark robe stands facing an enormous ancient gate with spiked iron doors, arms raised emitting magical light from both hands, the massive stone pillars on either side covered in glowing golden runes and symbols, an ornate golden chain and lock stretched across the open gate, misty castle visible in the background, dramatic lighting, purple twilight sky, detailed stone textures and cracks on the ground, fantasy scene
